$schema: the hand-written op-plan cases, one entry per case in the shape of ./_schema.md; `file` is the case's stable label (historically its NNN- filename)

cases.name: rotate-default-times
cases.reason: times defaults to 1

cases.name: filter-sepia
cases.reason: NOTE: the extension registers a DIFFERENT op under the same name "filter" (its panel list filter) — this core shape is invalid there (unknown field "mode"); see filter-core-shape-in-extension

cases.name: filter-custom-tint
cases.reason: mixed-case hex is accepted

cases.name: layout-empty-lines-clears
cases.reason: empty lines array removes every drawn line (contract §2); mcp prompt omits that sentence but the shape is valid there too

cases.name: formula-power
cases.reason: ** is two chars of the allowed charset

cases.name: save-with-path
cases.reason: contract §2 gives save an optional "path" (string ≤ 1024 chars, never a URL); every surface carrying save accepts it — desktop and cli honour it under the user-echo guard, mcp honours it relative to the run's output_dir (traversal-guarded), browser, pystencil and bot accept it and note+skip the destination

cases.name: accent-color
cases.reason: pystencil does not register accent (no theme) — unknown-op skip there, same verdict

cases.name: accent-preset
cases.reason: preset form: browser/desktop/cli; the extension accent takes only "color" — excluded from its profile

cases.name: linestyle-pointcolor-empty
cases.reason: "" = follow the stroke colour

cases.name: copy-what-layout
cases.reason: the cli console copy bullet says "Takes no fields" — the "what" widening is editor-only

cases.name: removeproject-name
cases.reason: the bot lists removeProject among its FORBIDDEN ops (server-side destruction) — editor-only here

cases.name: projectcolor-clear
cases.reason: "" restores the theme accent

cases.name: openfile-path
cases.reason: openFile is desktop + cli only (contract §8); browser and pystencil skip it as unknown — same verdict, different effect

cases.name: reset-unknown-in-editor
cases.reason: editors have no single reset control — unknown-op skip with a warning per contract §2

cases.name: reconnect-server
cases.reason: cli-only console op; pystencil skips it as unknown

cases.name: delete-local-project-file
cases.reason: cli + pystencil console op; NOTE the bot lists "delete" among its FORBIDDEN ops — never widen this profile to bot

cases.name: ext-open-with-actions
cases.reason: core ops are legal only NESTED under open.actions in the extension profile

cases.name: ext-scantab
cases.reason: assumes the shared-tabs listing is on and holds the index; with shareTabs off the op fails for want of indices

cases.name: ext-theme-system
cases.reason: the extension theme adds a third "system" mode the editors reject

cases.name: ext-filter-panel
cases.reason: the extension "filter" op is the panel list filter — same name as the core pixel filter, different grammar

cases.name: ext-variants-dropped
cases.reason: extension plans must not use variants (§8) — implementation drops them all with a warning rather than failing

cases.name: filter-core-shape-in-extension
cases.reason: name collision: "filter" exists in the extension as the panel filter, so the core shape hits a KNOWN op with unknown field "mode" and fails the plan instead of skip-as-unknown

cases.name: theme-mode-system-in-editor
cases.reason: editor theme mode is strictly light|dark; only the extension adds "system"

cases.name: variants-9-invalid
cases.reason: more than 8 variants

cases.name: frame-indices-33-invalid
cases.reason: more than 32 frame indices
